screen.stormlight.way_of_kings.cutting.t: Gems: chisel | Large gems: diamond chisel at level 5
screen.stormlight.way_of_kings.article.s: Spheres hold Stormlight. Gemstone type and sphere size determine their capacity; the tooltip shows the current charge. Highstorms refill exposed spheres. A dun sphere is empty, but can be infused again. Raw cut gemstones cannot hold Stormlight.

Equip a sphere pouch containing infused spheres. Hold B to breathe Stormlight into your personal reserve; hold Shift + B to return it to spheres. These are the default controls and can be rebound. Drawing light wears a sphere down. Recharging does not repair it. Health is ten times capacity; at zero it disappears. Below 80% health, passive leakage increases as health falls. Leakage causes no wear.
screen.stormlight.way_of_kings.article.c: Craft a chisel with an iron ingot diagonally above-right of a stick. Load a gemstone into the gemcutting table, wait for the vise to close, then strike ten times with the chisel. Ordinary gems yield raw chips or marks. Each completed survival cut advances Gem Cutting. At Gem Cutting level 5 (40 completed cuts), use a diamond chisel to cut large gemstones into raw broams. Craft the diamond chisel with a diamond in place of iron. See the Gem Cutting tab for all yield odds. Sneak-use an empty hand to retrieve a loaded gem.

Place a sphere forging table with its full 3 by 2 by 2 space clear. Fuel the hearth with a lava bucket or furnace fuel, then add glass to the crucible. Fit a chip, mark or broam mould on the casting bench and place the matching raw cut inside. A chip needs one molten glass; a mark needs two; a broam needs three. Use the bench with an empty hand to turn the tap. Wait for the sphere to cool, then collect it. Moulds are reusable. Sneak-use an empty hand to remove the gem, then the mould. Newly forged spheres are dun: infuse them in a highstorm.
screen.stormlight.way_of_kings.article.s: Highstorms replenish Stormlight in exposed spheres. Take spheres into the storm or put them in a sphere jar with open sky above it. A roof blocks sky exposure. Charging happens gradually during the storm, so leave spheres exposed while they fill.

An equipped pouch lets your carried sphere storage receive Stormlight when you are exposed. Watch the charge tooltip to check progress. Store charged spares before spending your reserve. Highstorms refill charge, but never restore a worn sphere's health.

Use a sphere pouch to equip it or swap it with the equipped pouch. It grants access to sixteen sphere slots in your inventory. Breathing draws from this storage. Removing the pouch leaves the spheres stored, but inaccessible until you equip a pouch again.

Use sphere jars to keep spare spheres together and expose them to highstorms for charging. Sphere lanterns hold a sphere and use its infusion for light; a dun sphere provides no infused glow. Stored spheres retain their wear, and damaged spheres can still leak while stored.
screen.stormlight.way_of_kings.article.r: Combine a book and an amethyst shard in any arrangement to craft a Mysterious Book. Drop it on the ground under open sky during a highstorm. Leave it exposed for about one minute, then wait for the lightning sequence to transform it into Words of Radiance. Pick it up and place it on a lectern to choose your order. Your choice is permanent. Spend experience levels to unlock Radiant milestones; Your Order shows your rank and next milestone. Radiant progression is separate from Gem Cutting.

Infused personal Stormlight powers your unlocked abilities. G controls gravitational lashings; later milestones add vertical movement and other benefits. External Lashing unlocks at Radiant level 10 and uses H by default. Check Words of Radiance for unlock details. Controls can be changed in the key bindings menu.
screen.stormlight.way_of_kings.article.s: Your Spren Bond grows with your Radiant progression. Bond levels unlock at Radiant levels 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9. This is a different progression from Gem Cutting. Words of Radiance shows the bond and its ideals.

At Spren Bond 1, press V by default to send your nearby spren searching for gemstone ore within 75 blocks. If it finds a lead, it returns to guide you. Follow its trail. Spren Seek has a cooldown; messages report when it is searching, returning or ready again. Use the control again to cancel an active search.
